changes: Rebuilt the desktop interface with PySide6 and QML while preserving the existing VK Play client-launch workflow.
Added a frameless, always-on-top window with a draggable title area and working minimize and close controls.
Added DPI-aware proportional positioning so interactive controls stay aligned with the background artwork on scaled Windows displays.
Added the transparent Crimson Archer theme with a red, black, and silver visual style.
Added a group selector and a scrollable client list with class icons, selected states, hover feedback, and disabled states.
Consolidated application settings, group management, update checks, and the debug toggle into a single Settings hub.
Added in-app group creation, renaming, deletion, multi-account editing, and class assignment with atomic account-file updates.
Added an in-app configuration editor with checkbox controls for update and memory-cleanup options.
Added visual screen-point and OCR-region selection tools with display-bound validation and automatic launcher hiding during capture.
Added a scrollable live log, progress indicator, debug mode, launch summary, failed-account reporting, and retry support.
Added an option to clean memory before launching each selected client.
Added an optional standalone MemoryCleaner that starts after the launcher closes, cleans immediately, and repeats every three minutes.
Added single-instance coordination for the background cleaner and automatic shutdown of the cleaner when the launcher or updater starts.
Added automatic update checks at startup, enabled by default, while keeping manual update checks available from Settings.
Updated the Windows build to package the QML interface, active theme, updater, and background memory cleaner.
